svg.aria-label: quire-verification-contracts owns five shared vocabularies: the five public verification contracts with their error codes, bounded JSON intake, RFC 8785 identity, the shared-reference packet and the checked-operation catalog. The private quire-verification re-exports all of it, quire-protocol uses the contracts directly, quire-contract-ir reads the catalog, and the packet is a temporary copy from the private quire-specification.
